After teasing X followers on Sunday with a chart and the question “Orange or Green?”, Saylor confirmed the bitcoin purchase on Monday. Notably, […]
articles.title: Saylor Strengthens BTC and Cash Stashes as Strategy Adds 1,287 Bitcoin
